meta.title: Lighter.xyz Broker Adapter Skeleton & Authentication
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create the LighterBrokerAdapter class that authenticates with Lighter.xyz API to establish secure connections for trading.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: LighterBrokerAdapter class exists extending BrokerAdapter ABC
Private key loaded securely via priority: env var → encrypted keystore → direct parameter (with warning)
Private key validation: 64 hex chars, derives wallet address, logs masked address
connect() establishes connection, verifies credentials, selects testnet/mainnet URL
Invalid credentials raise LighterKeyError with helpful message, no sensitive data

key-tasks.task: Implement _validate_private_key() with format/length check, address derivation
Implement encrypted keystore support with Fernet
Implement connect() async method with URL selection

architecture-context.pattern: 1. Environment variable (RECOMMENDED) 2. Encrypted keystore + encryption key 3. Direct parameter (NOT RECOMMENDED, logs warning)
architecture-context.constraint: API keys and private keys MUST never be logged (NFR13)
Credentials from environment variables or secure config (NFR14)

technical-specifications.spec:
class LighterBrokerAdapter(BrokerAdapter): MAINNET_API_URL = "https://mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/" TESTNET_API_URL = "https://testnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/"
def __init__( self, private_key: str | None = None, encrypted_key_path: str | None = None, encryption_key: str | None = None, testnet: bool = True, # Default to testnet ) -> None: self._testnet = testnet self._private_key = self._load_private_key(...) self._client = None self._connected = False

nfr-references.nfr: API keys and private keys MUST never be logged
Credentials from environment variables or secure config
